entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: Skoti god of fury and thunder from Kaldheim, a fearless risk-taker, eldest son of Alrund and Cosima.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: Toralf's father, who thinks his son is wasting his talents.

entities.name: Chasm Beast
entities.description: Beast in the deepest trench of Karfell's ocean.

entities.name: Skyfang Forge
entities.description: Forge struck by Toralf's hammer, making two realms collide.

entities.name: Toralf's Hammer
entities.description: Tyrite hammer imbued with the power of thunder.

events.summary: Toralf plucks a hair off Metar, carves his mark on the Chasm Beast and collides two realms with his hammer.
events.quote: He made two realms collide just by swinging his hammer against the Skyfang Forge.

relations.quote: Toralf is the eldest son of Alrund and Cosima
